cuts.desc: Marble restroom: close on Davi at the sink, Rocha's tuxedo shoulder blurred behind; Davi's eyes slide toward the door (toward the table)
IMAGINATION (desaturated, dreamy edge): Rastro pops beside Lia's table on the terrace, Davi appears, reaches for her hand
IMAGINATION: close on the two hands clasping -> both blink out in a Rastro; the dream image cracks like glass
Top-down map of Monaco (coast, harbour, streets); red pins rain onto every place Davi has been, one per saved photo
Map pull-back, pins turn into tiny black suits standing on every spot; HUD 'A LINHA VIU' with red pin count
Globe pull-back from Monaco; a red can chip pops ('A LATA': what he carries keeps the old ground speed)
Globe: Monaco -> Lisbon dotted arc; two yellow ground-speed arrows at different angles on each city
Vector diagram: two arrows tail-to-tail, the red difference arrow grows; red silhouette of Lia rides it; HUD LIA 400 km/h
Lisbon street-level: red silhouette streaks in with speed lines and smashes into a ring of impact lines; heavy shake
Globe swings south, latitude 43.7 N lit as a gold ring through Monaco; camera tilts toward the equator
The equator becomes a glowing mirror line; Monaco's pin flips across it and lands at 43.7 S (blue)
Angle wedges from the globe's centre: 43 N up, 43 S down; HUD '43° N = 43° S'
Meridian 7.4 E lights pole to pole; a pulse runs from Monaco to the mirror point; equal speed arrows 1.210 km/h
Crash zoom into 43.7 S south-west of Cape Town: nothing but ocean; dissolves into a dark sea from above
Low over a dark, grey-green cold sea, spray and overcast sky; HUD 'ÁGUA 10 °C' and '43° S · 7° L'
Davi pops out of a Rastro above the cold sea, dives in, splash; HUD tag 'DAVI: OK'
Lia's head in the cold water, shivering, blue tint, breath vapour, chattering
Thermometer dropping 37 -> 30 °C, clock hand sweeping one hour; HUD 'HIPOTERMIA 1 h'
Restroom mirror: Rocha's reflection (tuxedo, sunglasses) smiles slowly; push-in
Extreme close on Davi deciding, jaw set, eyes close -> on 'sozinho' a Rastro swallows him, flash
Restroom wide: shockwave rings blast from the empty spot, tissues fly, mirror bursts into a spiderweb crack
Slow-motion: cracked mirror close, Rocha reflected in many shards, pieces drifting; push-in
Rocha walks out of the restroom door into the warm salon, tugging his glove
Wide night terrace: string lights, sea and yachts, white tablecloths; push toward a lone table
Medium: Lia alone at the table with two plates, waiting, looking at the empty chair
Rocha drops into Davi's chair across from Lia; Lia's smile fades
Detail: black glove slides Lia's phone off the white tablecloth
Lia's phone in the glove: camera shutter on Lia at the table, then send to DAVI (whoosh)
Far away: Davi alone on a dark empty beach at night; phone buzzes, the screen lights his face
Davi's phone screen: the photo arrives; detail on the table, two plates
Photo: snap pan to Lia's face, unsmiling
Photo pull-back: the whole terrace, string lights, sea
Message bubble types in under the photo: 'Tu já viu esse lugar.'
Close: Davi staring at the screen, cold phone light on his face, sea behind
Detail: his thumb hovering over the photo, trembling, not touching
Extreme close on Davi's eyes with the photo reflected; slow push; blink -> hard cut
Hard cut to black (tail)
